briefing.text: Street Fighter won the weekend with $31 million in North America and $51 million worldwide.
Anthropic plans to put 5% of its shares into a new fund for charity and AI job impacts.
Chip stocks fell for an eighth straight day amid doubts about AI spending.
Sam Altman confirmed OpenAI is building a humanoid robot, with a demo expected in 2027.
Modern Warfare 4's campaign is 92% positive on Steam ahead of its October 23 launch.

stories.title: Street Fighter wins the weekend with $31 million and $51 million worldwide
stories.summary: Paramount's Street Fighter opened at No. 1 in North America and added $20.1 million from 65 overseas markets.
stories.why: A hit shows video game films can keep drawing crowds, and it lands in a big year for game adaptations.
stories.happened: Street Fighter took an estimated $31 million from 3,575 theaters, including $4 million in previews and $5.4 million from IMAX. That is close to Masters of the Universe's $29.4 million start but below Mortal Kombat II's $38.5 million. Audiences gave it a B- CinemaScore.
stories.next: Watch for how far it drops next weekend with a B- CinemaScore.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The fighting game series has been popular since the early 1990s.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Video game adaptations have been reliable earners at the box office.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It is being measured against Mortal Kombat II's opening.

stories.background: Street Fighter is Capcom's long-running fighting game series, first adapted for film in 1994.

meme.top: Audiences gave it a B-
meme.bottom: The box office gave it $51 million
meme.take: Street Fighter won the weekend on points rather than by knockout. The belt still counts.

stories.title: Apple staff are reported to warn iPhone Duo shoppers against walk-ins
stories.summary: With the $1,999 foldable sold out into late January, some Apple Store staff were told to discourage launch-day walk-ins.
stories.why: It is Apple's first new iPhone shape in years and its most expensive phone ever.
stories.happened: MacRumors reports some staff were told walk-in stock will likely be unavailable on October 23. Within 30 minutes of preorders, US shipping estimates hit January 25. Apple told the Financial Times demand was 'nothing short of extraordinary.'
stories.next: Watch for launch-day stock on October 23 and pickup availability from October 24.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: It is Apple's first foldable phone.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A $1,999 starting price is the highest for an iPhone.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Shipping dates slipped into 2027 within half an hour.

stories.background: Apple makes the iPhone, the world's best-selling smartphone line.

meme.top: Apple's folding phone launches Friday
meme.bottom: Please do not come to the launch
meme.take: Apple Stores are asking iPhone Duo fans to stay home on launch day. A first for a queue.

stories.title: Anthropic commits 5% of its shares to a new Public Benefit Fund
stories.summary: Anthropic plans to put 5% of its equity into a fund for charity and AI job impacts, with more added as its value rises.
stories.why: Equity in a top AI lab could become one of the largest pools of charitable money in tech.
stories.happened: The 5% needs stockholder approval, and the board may add 2% for each 50% rise in value above a baseline. With founder and staff pledges, about 20% of shares go to public good. The fund's equity cannot be used for lobbying or political giving.
stories.next: Watch for the fund's governance details, which Anthropic says it will share in coming months.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A slice of one of the most valuable AI companies is being set aside.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: Few tech companies have pledged equity to charity on this scale.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Anthropic is one of the most closely watched AI labs.

stories.background: Anthropic is the San Francisco AI company that makes the Claude family of models.

meme.top: An AI lab is giving away its shares
meme.bottom: The more it is worth, the more it gives
meme.take: Anthropic's new charity grows with its valuation. Rarely has a board had more reason to care.

stats.label: of shares for public good overall

stories.title: Nathan Fielder's Holmes film opens to $15 million, a documentary near-record
stories.summary: A24's You Can See Everything took about $15 million from just 855 theaters, the second-best non-fiction opening ever.
stories.why: Fielder has a devoted following, and the Theranos story remains one of tech's best-known scandals.
stories.happened: The film averaged about $17,544 per theater, beating weekend estimates. Only Fahrenheit 9/11's $23.9 million in 2004 opened higher for non-fiction. Fielder directed it with Lance Oppenheim, and it reportedly cost about $7 million.
stories.next: Watch for A24 widening the release beyond 855 theaters.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Nathan Fielder's TV work has a large cult audience.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Elizabeth Holmes's Theranos fraud is still widely discussed.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Its 4.8 Letterboxd score is the highest the site has recorded.

stories.background: Elizabeth Holmes founded the blood-testing company Theranos and was convicted of fraud in 2022.

meme.top: A documentary about Theranos
meme.bottom: Turned in real numbers
meme.take: A film about faked test results posted a $15 million opening that actually checks out.

stories.title: Sam Altman confirms OpenAI is building a humanoid robot
stories.summary: OpenAI's chief said the company will build a humanoid robot and expects a demo in 2027, with 27 robotics jobs listed.
stories.why: OpenAI moving into physical robots would put it up against Tesla and a fast-growing field of robot makers.
stories.happened: Asked on OpenAI's Sources podcast whether it will build a humanoid, Altman said it will. He told Fortune he expects a demo in 2027 but robots on city streets a few years later. OpenAI has not said what the robot will look like or cost.
stories.next: Watch for details of the 2027 demo and any hardware partners OpenAI names.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: OpenAI makes ChatGPT, one of the most used apps in the world.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Tesla has spent years on its own Optimus humanoid.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Humanoid robots are drawing heavy investment across the industry.

stories.background: OpenAI is the San Francisco AI company behind ChatGPT. It worked on robot hands in its early years.

meme.top: OpenAI is building a humanoid robot
meme.bottom: The demo is pencilled in for 2027
meme.take: OpenAI will build a robot with a human shape, since the world was built for people. For now.

stories.title: Modern Warfare 4's campaign hits 92% positive on Steam ahead of launch
stories.summary: About 2,900 of 3,156 Steam reviews recommend the early-access campaign, with DMZ opening October 20 and full launch October 23.
stories.why: Call of Duty is gaming's biggest annual series, and early player reaction shapes its launch.
stories.happened: Campaign early access opened October 16 for digital preorders, so reviews cover story mode only. DMZ early access starts October 20 and multiplayer arrives at full launch on October 23, Gaming Route reports.
stories.next: Watch for whether scores hold once multiplayer opens on October 23.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Call of Duty sells millions of copies every year.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It launches weeks before GTA VI.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Activision calls it one of the two biggest games of the year.

stories.background: Call of Duty is Activision's shooter series, now owned by Microsoft.

meme.top: Players like the new Call of Duty
meme.bottom: They have not played online yet
meme.take: Modern Warfare 4 is 92% positive on Steam, a figure multiplayer arrives Friday to review.

stories.title: PlayStation 6 memory alone is claimed to cost over $680 per console
stories.summary: An insider says RAM and storage costs could push the next PlayStation past $1,000, as AI data centers drive memory prices up.
stories.why: A $1,000 console would be a big shift for players used to $500 launch prices.
stories.happened: Leaker Kepler_L2 said in a forum post that PS6 memory and storage costs exceed $680, but should fall once the design is final, VGC reports. Analysts quoted expect next-gen consoles near or above $1,000. Sony has not announced pricing.
stories.next: Watch for Sony's own comments on PS6 timing and price.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Memory costs alone would exceed a typical console price.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI data center demand has made memory chips scarce.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Players are watching closely for next-gen news.

stories.background: The PlayStation 5 launched in 2020 and now costs over 50% more than at launch, VGC notes.

meme.top: The PS6 needs a lot of memory
meme.bottom: So will the payment plan
meme.take: The PS6's memory reportedly costs more than a PS5 did. Gamers will remember this.

stories.title: Chip stocks fall for an eighth straight day as AI spending doubts grow
stories.summary: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index dropped 3.83% on Friday, ending the week down 11.4%, led by memory makers.
stories.why: Chip stocks have driven the market for years, so a long slide signals doubts about the AI boom.
stories.happened: The Nasdaq fell 2.15%. Seagate, Western Digital, SanDisk, SK Hynix and Micron fell between about 5.6% and 7.5%, and CoreWeave dropped 11.9%. Reports cite doubts about AI returns, debt-funded buildouts, inflation and oil near $110.
stories.next: Watch for whether chip stocks steady this week and what big tech says about spending in earnings.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Hundreds of billions in market value are at stake.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Investors question whether AI spending will pay off.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Memory makers had led the AI rally.

stories.background: The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index tracks the largest US-listed chip companies.

meme.top: Chip stocks fell eight days running
meme.bottom: Somewhere a GPU is overheating anyway
meme.take: Investors have discovered that AI data centers cost money. The chip index took it personally.

stories.title: Anthropic is reported to pitch its own AI safety bill to US lawmakers
stories.summary: Anthropic's draft would let authorities block a frontier model only for imminent risks above $1 billion or harm to over 50 people, reports say.
stories.why: An AI company writing the rules for its own industry is likely to draw attention from both supporters and critics.
stories.happened: Politico reports the draft covers biological weapons, cyberattacks and models that evade their developer's controls. It would also create independent evaluators registered with the Commerce Department. It is a proposal, not law.
stories.next: Watch for whether any lawmaker introduces the bill and how rival AI companies respond.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Critics often question AI companies shaping their own oversight.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: The bill targets bioweapons and AI that slips its controls.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: AI regulation is an active debate in Washington.

stories.background: Anthropic is the AI company behind Claude and has long argued for safety rules on advanced AI.

meme.top: An AI company drafted an AI law
meme.bottom: It set the bar at a billion dollars
meme.take: Anthropic drafted its own AI safety bill, sparing lawmakers the hard part: understanding AI.

stories.title: GTA VI's launch trailer gets picked apart a month before release
stories.summary: Rockstar's 90-second launch trailer is still being analysed, with Digital Foundry doubting it uses the PS5's new upscaler.
stories.why: GTA VI is one of the most anticipated games ever, and this is the last look before release.
stories.happened: Rockstar released the launch trailer on October 15, set to music by Justice, VGC reports. Digital Foundry's Richard Leadbetter said he doubts the PS5-captured footage uses the QSSR upscaler. The game launches November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
stories.next: Watch for preload details and early reviews before November 19.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: GTA V is one of the best-selling games of all time.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Fans have waited over a decade for a new main entry.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The game is just over a month from launch.

stories.background: Grand Theft Auto is Rockstar Games' open-world crime series. Rockstar is owned by Take-Two.

meme.top: Ninety seconds of GTA VI footage
meme.bottom: Analysed one frame at a time
meme.take: GTA VI's trailer has now been studied more closely than most school textbooks.

stories.title: Anthropic says AI agents now log six times more work hours than its staff
stories.summary: An Anthropic report on its own workforce says agent work hours far outnumber employee hours and junior technical hiring has dropped sharply.
stories.why: It is a rare inside look at how an AI lab's own jobs are changing, and junior roles are the worry.
stories.happened: Anthropic's report says agent work hours passed human hours in March and reached six to one by August. The junior share of technical hiring fell from 27% to 9%, and the junior share of technical staff from 21% to 14%.
stories.next: Watch for whether other tech companies publish similar figures on their own hiring.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Entry-level jobs are the ones the figures suggest are shrinking.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: Few companies have published data like this about their own staff.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Anthropic is one of the most closely watched AI labs.

stories.background: Anthropic is the San Francisco AI company that makes the Claude family of models.

meme.top: The agents now work six times more
meme.bottom: Nobody has asked them about a pension
meme.take: Anthropic's agents now outwork its staff six to one and still have no say in the holiday rota.

stories.title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 arrives on Netflix on October 20
stories.summary: The 10-episode standalone sequel to the 2022 anime is out Tuesday, with Cyberpunk 2077 on sale for 70% off on Steam.
stories.why: The first Edgerunners was a surprise hit that sent players back to Cyberpunk 2077.
stories.happened: CD Projekt Red and Studio Trigger made the series, directed by Kai Ikarashi, with a new cast led by Weak and D. Viewers do not need to have seen the first season. Cyberpunk 2077 is $17.99 on Steam until October 26.
stories.next: Watch for whether it lifts Cyberpunk 2077's player numbers as the first season did.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: The first season was one of the most popular game adaptations on Netflix.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A 70% game discount is timed to the launch.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Studio Trigger is a leading anime studio.

stories.background: Cyberpunk 2077 is CD Projekt Red's open-world game set in the dystopian Night City.

meme.top: A new season of a sad cyberpunk anime
meme.bottom: The game is 70% off for the grief
meme.take: Edgerunners 2 arrives Tuesday, and CD Projekt has priced the game for the emotional rebound.

stories.title: Valve prices the Steam Frame headset from $1,059
stories.summary: Valve's Steam Frame costs $1,059 with 256GB or $1,299 with 1TB, with reservation holders able to order by December or in 2027.
stories.why: Valve's hardware sets the tone for PC VR, and the price is higher than many fans hoped.
stories.happened: Gaming Route reports the Steam Frame is priced at $1,059 for 256GB and $1,299 for 1TB. People who reserved one can place orders by December or in 2027, depending on their place in the queue.
stories.next: Watch for review units and how quickly the reservation queue moves.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A price above $1,000 puts it in premium headset territory.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Valve's Steam platform dominates PC gaming.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Players have waited years for new Valve VR hardware.

stories.background: Valve runs the Steam store and makes hardware such as the Steam Deck and the Index VR headset.

meme.top: Valve's new headset costs $1,059
meme.bottom: The queue to buy it is free
meme.take: Valve's headset starts at $1,059, and some buyers get to wait until 2027 at no extra charge.

stories.title: Anthropic says Claude solved the mystery of where NIST's curve seeds came from
stories.summary: Claude traced the seeds behind widely used NIST elliptic curves to a simple random generator seeded with timestamps, Anthropic says.
stories.why: Those curves protect much of the web, and the unexplained seeds fed backdoor theories for decades.
stories.happened: Anthropic says Claude worked out in under half an hour that the seeds came from the lrand48 generator seeded with Unix timestamps. It says this is not a cryptographic break and makes a backdoor less plausible. A $36,864 bounty is going to the Internet Security Research Group.
stories.next: Watch for cryptographers checking the method and the curve parts that remain unexplained.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: The origin of the seeds had gone unexplained for decades.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: NIST's P-256 curve secures a large share of web traffic.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI labs are showing models doing original research work.

stories.background: NIST is the US standards agency. Its elliptic curves are used for encryption and digital signatures.

meme.top: Decades of backdoor theories
meme.bottom: The answer was a clock
meme.take: Claude found the secret behind NIST's mystery curves: someone looked at the time.

stories.title: Samsung is reported to use rival TSMC to make base dies for Nvidia's custom memory
stories.summary: Samsung will reportedly tap TSMC's 3nm process for the base die of Nvidia's custom HBM, its first such handoff.
stories.why: It shows how tight AI memory supply is, pushing even fierce rivals to work together.
stories.happened: Seoul Economic Daily reports Nvidia is co-designing the base die with both firms. TSMC's 3nm yield is estimated above 90%, against about 60% for Samsung's 2nm. UBS projects HBM demand up 91% next year, ahead of supply.
stories.next: Watch for confirmation from Samsung, TSMC or Nvidia.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Samsung and TSMC compete head to head in chipmaking.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: HBM demand is forecast to nearly double next year.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Nvidia is the leading maker of AI chips.

stories.background: HBM is stacked high-speed memory used alongside AI processors such as Nvidia's GPUs.

meme.top: Samsung needed a better chip line
meme.bottom: So it called the competition
meme.take: Samsung is reportedly hiring TSMC to help build Nvidia's memory. Rivalry has a price.

stories.title: Banks, airlines and retailers are locking AI agents out of their sites
stories.summary: Amazon, Delta and major US banks are blocking outside AI agents such as Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots from acting for users.
stories.why: AI agents are pitched as doing errands for you, which only works if websites let them in.
stories.happened: Reports say Amazon removed Meta's Muse from its store, Delta blocks outside agents from booking, and big banks keep bots out of accounts. Schwab's chief said it blocks dozens to hundreds of agent attempts in weekly reports.
stories.next: Watch for paid deals between AI companies and the sites now blocking them.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Sites want to keep customers on their own apps and ads.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Banks cite account security and fraud.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Sponsored listings and ad revenue are at stake.

stories.background: AI agents are chatbots that can take actions such as shopping or booking on a user's behalf.

meme.top: AI agents were promised to run errands
meme.bottom: The shops have stopped letting them in
meme.take: AI agents can now do your shopping, provided the shop is not one you have heard of.

stories.title: Antonio Banderas and Nicolas Cage join True Detective season 5
stories.summary: HBO confirmed the two stars for the next season, reportedly set in New York's Jamaica Bay, with filming in 2027.
stories.why: True Detective's casting is always a talking point after its famous first season.
stories.happened: Banderas will play Rai Garcia and Cage will play Henry Logan, Deadline reports. Issa López, who wrote and directed season 4, returns as showrunner. Production begins in 2027.
stories.next: Watch for more casting and a release window from HBO.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Nicolas Cage and Antonio Banderas are both well-known film stars.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The first season set a high bar for prestige TV.

stories.background: True Detective is HBO's crime anthology series. Each season has a new cast and story.

meme.top: Nicolas Cage joins True Detective
meme.bottom: The swamp has met its match
meme.take: HBO cast Nicolas Cage in a bleak crime drama, a genre about to become slightly less bleak.

stories.title: Hack exposes data on about 7 million California public school students
stories.summary: A compromised login at testing provider Education Testing Service exposed names, addresses, demographics and disability status.
stories.why: It is one of the largest breaches of student records, and it involves children's data.
stories.happened: An unauthorized party used a compromised credential to copy files between May 22 and September 18, DataBreaches.net reports. The data covers students over the past three school years. The California Department of Education announced the breach.
stories.next: Watch for how families will be notified and what support is offered.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: About 7 million students are affected.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Disability status is among the most sensitive data exposed.

stories.background: The testing provider runs statewide assessments for California under contract with the state.

meme.top: Seven million students' records exposed
meme.bottom: Through one stolen login
meme.take: Seven million students' records went out through a single login. Plain and serious.

stories.title: New Macs are reported for November 6 as a new iPad mini case leaks
stories.summary: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman says new Macs arrive November 6, and a filing for an unreleased iPad mini case hints at a redesign.
stories.why: Apple's fall lineup is filling out after the iPhone Duo and HomeView launches.
stories.happened: An unreleased Smart Folio, model A3632, appeared in a French regulatory database with more magnet material than the current case, Android Headlines reports. Rumors point to an OLED iPad mini. Gurman reports a November 6 release for new Macs.
stories.next: Watch for an Apple announcement confirming the new Macs and iPad mini.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: New Apple hardware draws wide attention.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It would land just before the holiday season.

stories.background: The iPad mini is Apple's smallest tablet. It was last updated in 2024.

meme.top: Apple's next iPad mini leaked
meme.bottom: Its case could not keep quiet
meme.take: Apple's next iPad mini was given away by its case, the least discreet accessory Apple makes.

stories.title: Investors are reported to push back on Nscale's $35 billion IPO goal
stories.summary: Investors reportedly want the AI cloud firm valued at $16 billion to $19 billion, about half what it is seeking.
stories.why: Nscale is a test of how much markets will pay for AI data center builders.
stories.happened: Bloomberg reports investor concerns include a Norwegian site running at 6.4 MW against a 30 MW target and only about 2.5% of a $103.4 billion backlog active. Microsoft's exit as a UK anchor tenant was also cited.
stories.next: Watch for Nscale's final pricing and whether it delays the listing.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The gap between the asking and offered value is about half.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Delays at its sites raise doubts about its backlog.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI cloud firms are rushing to raise money on public markets.

stories.background: Nscale is a British company that builds and rents out data centers for AI computing.

meme.top: Nscale asked for $35 billion
meme.bottom: Investors offered the working half
meme.take: Nscale wants $35 billion. Investors would like to see the missing 23.6 megawatts first.

stories.title: John Wilson is reported to be making a Harry Styles tour documentary
stories.summary: The How To with John Wilson creator is filming Styles' 30-night Madison Square Garden residency, with a cinema release under consideration.
stories.why: It pairs one of pop's biggest stars with one of TV's most distinctive documentary voices.
stories.happened: Variety reports Wilson has filmed the residency since August, covering concerts, the production and fans and crew. Universal Pictures has worldwide rights. The residency runs until October 31, and no release date is set.
stories.next: Watch for Universal confirming a theatrical release.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Harry Styles is one of the world's biggest pop stars.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Consequence calls the residency the largest single run in the venue's history.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Concert films have become big earners in cinemas.

stories.background: John Wilson made the HBO series How To with John Wilson, known for its odd New York street footage.

meme.top: John Wilson is filming Harry Styles
meme.bottom: Expect several minutes of pigeons
meme.take: Harry Styles hired the man who films New York's scaffolding. Bold for a pop documentary.

stories.title: Valve's invite-only Deadlock passes 300,000 players on Steam
stories.summary: Deadlock hit a peak of 303,347 concurrent players, making it Steam's fourth most-played game while still invite-only.
stories.why: A game this popular without even being openly available is rare, and it hints at a big Valve launch ahead.
stories.happened: Deadlock peaked at 303,347 concurrent players, per SteamDB, Destructoid reports. New hero Violet arrived on October 16, and another hero, Nurse Harrow, is due on October 20.
stories.next: Watch for whether Nurse Harrow's arrival on October 20 pushes the record higher.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Over 300,000 at once ranks it among Steam's biggest games.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Players are still asking friends for invites.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Valve rarely releases new multiplayer games.

stories.background: Deadlock is Valve's hero shooter mixed with a battle arena game, tested publicly by invitation.

meme.top: A game you need an invite for
meme.bottom: Three hundred thousand got one
meme.take: Deadlock is invite-only and has 303,000 players, which stretches the word exclusive.

stories.title: Apple launches HomeView, a $300 smart display, with a wider smart home lineup
stories.summary: Apple opened preorders for a 7-inch HomeView display, a new HomePod mini, Apple TV 4K and cameras, locks and thermostats.
stories.why: It is Apple's biggest push into the smart home, where Amazon and Google have long led.
stories.happened: HomeView costs $299 and launches November 13, with the new Apple TV 4K at $299 and HomePod mini 2 at $149, MacRumors reports. Some tabletop HomeView colors now ship in early December, and Siri AI arrives in a later update.
stories.next: Watch for reviews of HomeView and the accessories' shipping dates.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Amazon and Google dominate smart displays and speakers.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Any new Apple product category draws wide attention.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Commentators noted the higher prices of the new home devices.

stories.background: Apple Home is Apple's app and platform for controlling smart home devices from an iPhone.

meme.top: Apple made a screen for your kitchen
meme.bottom: The smart part arrives later
meme.take: Apple's HomeView ships in November. The smarter Siri will follow when it is ready.

stories.title: US lends up to $4.4 billion to restart three nuclear plants for AI power
stories.summary: The Energy Department is backing restarts at Palisades, Crane and Duane Arnold, restoring about 2.25 gigawatts mainly for data centers.
stories.why: AI data centers need huge amounts of power, and reviving shut reactors is one of the quickest ways to find it.
stories.happened: Crane, the former Three Mile Island plant, has a 20-year deal with Microsoft and a 2027 target. Palisades in Michigan must be online by March 2027 under its contracts. Duane Arnold in Iowa, owned by NextEra and working with Google, aims for early 2029.
stories.next: Watch for Palisades finishing fuel loading after a pause in its restart.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: 2.25 gigawatts is enough for about 2 million homes and businesses.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Microsoft and Google are tied to two of the plants.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Tech companies are turning to nuclear power for AI.

stories.background: Nuclear plants produce steady power around the clock, which data centers need.

meme.top: Three shut nuclear plants are reopening
meme.bottom: Chatbots need the night shift too
meme.take: America is reopening Three Mile Island so the chatbots can stay up late.

stories.title: Kid Rock releases a Christian album featuring Eminem
stories.summary: Halfway 2 Jesus includes Heal My Faith with Eminem, plus Lil Wayne and Jimmie Allen, despite the two rappers' opposite politics.
stories.why: The pairing crosses one of music's sharpest political divides.
stories.happened: Kid Rock wrote that he and Eminem have stayed friends despite different politics and hopes it sets an example. Eminem posted that it was about making music with an old friend, not choosing sides.
stories.next: Watch for how the album performs on the charts this week.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Kid Rock supports President Trump, and Eminem has criticized him.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Eminem is one of the best-selling rappers of all time.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Both are Michigan artists who rose to fame in the late 1990s.

stories.background: Kid Rock and Eminem are both Michigan musicians whose careers took off in the late 1990s.

meme.top: Kid Rock made a Christian album
meme.bottom: Eminem kept the faith on one track
meme.take: Kid Rock and Eminem disagree on almost everything except the royalty split.

stories.title: Konami's president says AI cannot replace the people behind great games
stories.summary: Hideki Hayakawa says generative AI will not change the games market much and that creators matter most.
stories.why: Game studios are split on AI, and a major publisher taking a clear stance draws attention.
stories.happened: In Konami's new business report, Hayakawa said teams create new ideas through a hard-to-replace 'chemical reaction', VGC reports. He said Konami still helps creators learn new tools and use them safely.
stories.next: Watch for how Konami's Metal Gear, Silent Hill and Castlevania projects use new tools.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: AI in game development divides players and developers.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Konami owns Metal Gear, Silent Hill and Castlevania.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Other industry leaders have backed AI for routine work this week.

stories.background: Konami is a Japanese publisher that has returned to big-budget games in recent years.

meme.top: Konami says games need human chemistry
meme.bottom: Silent Hill fans agree, nervously
meme.take: Konami says AI cannot replace people. The business report says so, and people wrote it.

stories.title: Led Zeppelin licenses Stairway to Heaven to a film for the first time, for Narnia
stories.summary: Greta Gerwig's Narnia: The Magician's Nephew uses the song in its new trailer, after the band turned down films for decades.
stories.why: Led Zeppelin almost never licenses its biggest song, so the trailer became an event of its own.
stories.happened: The new trailer for Narnia: The Magician's Nephew is set to Stairway to Heaven, JamBase reports. The band had refused films such as Wayne's World. The film gets a five-week theatrical run from February 12, 2027, then streams on Netflix from April 2.
stories.next: Watch for whether the song is also used in the film itself.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: The song had never been licensed to a film before.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Greta Gerwig directed Barbie, one of the biggest films of 2023.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Both Narnia and Led Zeppelin have audiences spanning generations.

stories.background: The Chronicles of Narnia are C.S. Lewis's fantasy novels. The Magician's Nephew tells how Narnia began.

meme.top: Led Zeppelin said no for fifty years
meme.bottom: Then a lion asked nicely
meme.take: Led Zeppelin turned down Wayne's World, then said yes to a talking lion. Standards.

stories.title: Footage leaks from a reportedly cancelled Assassin's Creed set in ancient China
stories.summary: Clips of Assassin's Creed Destiny, said to be made by Tencent's TiMi Studio, surfaced from developer portfolios.
stories.why: Fans have long asked for a mainline Assassin's Creed set in China.
stories.happened: MP1st first reported the footage, which shows a female assassin in the Qin Dynasty around 206 BCE and a boss fight with Xiang Yu, VGC reports. The game was reportedly planned for console and PC before being cancelled.
stories.next: Watch for any comment from Ubisoft or Tencent on the project.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Ancient China has long been a requested setting.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Assassin's Creed is Ubisoft's biggest series.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Cancelled projects point to wider cutbacks in the industry.

stories.background: Assassin's Creed is Ubisoft's historical action series. Tencent is a major investor in Ubisoft.

meme.top: Fans wanted Assassin's Creed in China
meme.bottom: They got a trailer for a cancelled one
meme.take: Assassin's Creed finally visited ancient China, briefly, in someone's portfolio.

stories.title: Tim Sweeney says AI can take over the routine work of coding
stories.summary: Epic's chief said about 70% of his time building Unreal Engine 1 went to routine typing and refactoring that AI can now handle.
stories.why: Epic makes the engine behind many games, so its chief's view on AI shapes how studios think about jobs.
stories.happened: Sweeney made the point in an X post on October 18, following his October 12 announcement of a 'huge pivot' at Epic, Gaming Route reports. Many replies pushed back.
stories.next: Watch for details of Epic's announced pivot.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Many developers worry AI will cost jobs.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Unreal Engine powers many of the biggest games.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It comes days after Epic said it is changing course.

stories.background: Tim Sweeney founded Epic Games, maker of Fortnite and Unreal Engine.

meme.top: Seventy percent of the work was typing
meme.bottom: The other thirty was Unreal
meme.take: Tim Sweeney says AI could have done most of his Unreal Engine typing. The engine is still his.

stats.label: time on routine coding, he said

stories.title: Verizon will charge $10 a month to share one number across two iPhones
stories.summary: Verizon plans a monthly fee for iOS 27's feature that lets one number switch between a main and companion iPhone.
stories.why: Carrier fees on new phone features tend to annoy customers, especially on a $1,999 phone.
stories.happened: MacRumors reports the feature lets one phone number move between two iPhones, with only one active at a time. Verizon says it is coming soon and will work with the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro.
stories.next: Watch for whether AT&T and T-Mobile charge for the feature too.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A $10 monthly fee adds $120 a year.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It arrives alongside the iPhone Duo launch.

stories.background: Verizon is the largest wireless carrier in the US by subscribers.

meme.top: Two iPhones, one phone number
meme.bottom: One extra bill
meme.take: Verizon will move your number between two iPhones for $10 a month. Leaving costs less.

stories.title: Korean publishers launch 'No Books, No AI' appeal over training on their books
stories.summary: Backed by 158 groups and 321 people, the appeal follows reports that Anthropic bought hundreds of thousands of Korean books for training.
stories.why: Copyright fights over AI training are spreading beyond the US to other countries' writers and publishers.
stories.happened: The Korean Publishers Society wants AI companies to record which works they train on and let rights holders check. Court records reportedly show Anthropic contracted with wholesaler Woongjin Booxen for an estimated 250,000 to 300,000 books.
stories.next: Watch for responses from Korea's government and National Assembly, where the appeal is being sent.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Writers say their books were used without fair pay.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Authors' lawsuits over AI training have grown worldwide.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Award-winning Korean authors are named in the reports.

stories.background: AI chatbots are trained on vast amounts of text, and books are among the most valued sources.

meme.top: An AI company bought a library
meme.bottom: The authors would like a word
meme.take: Anthropic reportedly read 300,000 Korean books. Publishers would like it to read one more.

stories.title: Liquid Swords, the studio behind Samson, goes bankrupt
stories.summary: The Swedish studio founded by a former Just Cause director is bankrupt after months of unpaid wages, with about 30 jobs affected.
stories.why: It adds to a long run of studio closures and job losses across the games industry.
stories.happened: Breakit reports Liquid Swords was declared bankrupt after failing to pay salaries for several months. The state will compensate about 30 staff, and the studio hopes to find a buyer. Samson launched in April 2026 to mixed reviews.
stories.next: Watch for whether a buyer takes on the studio or Samson.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Even studios that ship a game are struggling to stay afloat.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Studio closures have been frequent through 2026.

stories.background: Liquid Swords was founded in 2020 by Christofer Sundberg, co-founder of Avalanche Studios.

meme.top: Samson launched in April
meme.bottom: The studio closed in October
meme.take: Liquid Swords is bankrupt six months after shipping Samson, with about 30 staff affected.

stories.title: DeepSeek releases an open V4.1 Flash model with built-in web search
stories.summary: DeepSeek posted V4.1-Flash-1017 on Hugging Face under an MIT license, adding live search and page fetching.
stories.why: DeepSeek's cheap open models keep pressure on US labs' prices.
stories.happened: The model is a sparse mixture-of-experts with 552 billion total parameters and a one-million-token context window. DeepSeek's search and fetch tools cost $0.75 per 1,000 successful requests, according to its Hugging Face page.
stories.next: Watch for independent benchmark tests and how developers compare it with US models.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Chinese open models compete directly with US paid services.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Low prices are DeepSeek's main selling point.

stories.background: DeepSeek is a Chinese AI lab whose low-cost models drew wide attention in early 2025.

meme.top: DeepSeek's free model can now search
meme.bottom: The searching is not free
meme.take: DeepSeek gave away a 552-billion-parameter model and charged for the searching. Clever.

stories.title: Steam Next Fest opens today with a week of free demos
stories.summary: Valve's demo festival runs from October 19 to 26, with games such as Loftia and Stronghold 4 among those taking part.
stories.why: Next Fest is one of the biggest chances for small studios to get noticed.
stories.happened: The fest runs from 17:00 UTC on October 19 to the same time on October 26, Gaming Route reports. Loftia's demo is only playable during the fest, and Stronghold 4 adds skirmish mode.
stories.next: Watch for which demos climb Steam's wishlist charts during the week.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Hundreds of games usually take part.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: All demos are free with a Steam account.

stories.background: Valve runs Steam Next Fest three times a year to showcase upcoming games.

meme.top: A week of free game demos
meme.bottom: Your backlog has filed a complaint
meme.take: Steam Next Fest offers hundreds of free demos, a fine way to never finish one game.

stories.title: Meta releases Muse Spark Open, a huge open-weight model that runs on two Macs
stories.summary: Meta's 816-billion-parameter Muse Spark Open model is built for coding and agents and can run on two Mac Studio machines.
stories.why: Open-weight releases this large let developers run top-tier AI on their own hardware rather than through an API.
stories.happened: Meta released weights for Muse Spark Open, which uses 42 billion of its 816 billion parameters at a time and has a one-million-token context window. It was optimized with Apple to run on two M5 Ultra Mac Studios using Apple's MLX framework.
stories.next: Watch for independent benchmark results and how developers test it against Chinese open-weight rivals.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Meta is pitching it against open-weight models from Chinese labs.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: At 816 billion parameters it is one of the largest open-weight models released.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Apple helped optimize it to run on its Macs.

stories.background: Meta owns Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp, and has released open-weight AI models for several years.

meme.top: Meta's giant AI model runs at home
meme.bottom: If home has two Mac Studios
meme.take: Meta and Apple teamed up on AI, proving any rivalry can be paused for 816 billion parameters.

stories.title: Whalefall opens fourth with $8 million
stories.summary: Disney's survival thriller took about $8 million from 3,065 theaters, short of expectations, with a B CinemaScore.
stories.why: Original thrillers struggle for attention when franchise films share the weekend.
stories.happened: Whalefall placed behind Street Fighter, You Can See Everything and holdover Other Mommy, Boxoffice Pro reports. It averaged about $2,610 per theater and earned a B CinemaScore.
stories.next: Watch for its overseas results and second weekend drop.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: A story set inside a whale is an unusual premise.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It opened against Street Fighter.

stories.background: Whalefall is based on Daniel Kraus's 2023 novel and released by 20th Century Studios.

meme.top: A diver gets swallowed by a whale
meme.bottom: The box office knows the feeling
meme.take: Whalefall opened against Street Fighter and learned what being swallowed whole really means.

stories.title: New Sense and Sensibility opens to $7.25 million with an A- CinemaScore
stories.summary: Focus Features' Jane Austen adaptation took an estimated $7.25 million from 2,545 theaters, with audiences rating it highly.
stories.why: Period dramas rarely open big, but strong audience scores can keep them running for weeks.
stories.happened: Sense and Sensibility placed fifth for the weekend with about $7.25 million, Boxoffice Pro reports. Audiences gave it an A- CinemaScore. The 1995 version earned $43.18 million in North America.
stories.next: Watch for how it holds in coming weekends on word of mouth.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Austen adaptations have a loyal audience.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: An A- CinemaScore points to strong word of mouth.

stories.background: Sense and Sensibility is Jane Austen's 1811 novel, filmed most famously in 1995 with Emma Thompson.

meme.top: Two sisters, very little money
meme.bottom: Still outearned a whale
meme.take: Sense and Sensibility opened fifth, which in Austen terms is a respectable match.

stories.title: Chris Evans and Anya Taylor-Joy's Sacrifice climbs to No. 2 on Netflix
stories.summary: Netflix's hostage comedy, about a movie star taken captive by a cult at a charity gala, is its second most-watched US film.
stories.why: Two well-known leads made it one of the most visible streaming films of the weekend.
stories.happened: Sacrifice premiered on Netflix on October 16 and ranked second among Netflix films in the US on October 18, per FlixPatrol. Evans plays a fading star taken hostage by a radical leader played by Taylor-Joy.
stories.next: Watch for whether it enters Netflix's global top 10 this week.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Chris Evans and Anya Taylor-Joy have large fan bases.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It landed on a busy weekend for streaming releases.

stories.background: Chris Evans is best known as Captain America in Marvel's films.

meme.top: A movie star is taken hostage
meme.bottom: Calls it his best role in years
meme.take: In Sacrifice a fading star is kidnapped by a cult. His agent counts it as a booking.

stories.title: Sega pulls the Total War: Shogun 2 remaster after an 'Overwhelmingly Negative' launch
stories.summary: Sega is temporarily removing the remaster from sale and restoring the original game after players reported bugs and possible AI-upscaled art.
stories.why: It is a rare case of a publisher pulling a release within days, and it feeds wider worries about AI in game art.
stories.happened: The Shogun 2 Complete Edition launched October 13 and replaced the original on Steam. Players reported bugs, poor rendering and weak mod support, and reviews fell to 17% positive. Sega said on October 15 it would pull the game and restore the original.
stories.next: Watch for when the original returns to sale and what fixes Creative Assembly plans.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Players accused the studio of using AI upscaling on the game's art.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Shogun 2 is one of the most loved Total War games.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The pullback came two days after launch.

stories.background: Total War is Creative Assembly's strategy series. Shogun 2 first came out in 2011.

meme.top: They remastered a 2011 classic
meme.bottom: Fans asked for the 2011 one back
meme.take: Sega paid to upgrade Shogun 2 and is now paying to undo it. A very samurai retreat.

stories.title: Stolen ConnectWise credential used to sign in to 173 Microsoft 365 tenants
stories.summary: A compromised account for ConnectWise Cloud Backup was used to access Microsoft 365 tenants belonging to partners and customers.
stories.why: One stolen key reaching many companies is the supply chain risk security teams fear most.
stories.happened: The Hacker News reports a compromised Microsoft 365 credential tied to ConnectWise Cloud Backup, formerly SkyKick, was used for unauthorized sign-ins across 173 partner and customer tenants.
stories.next: Watch for ConnectWise's findings on what data was accessed.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: One credential opened doors at 173 organizations.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: IT service tools have wide access to client systems.

stories.background: ConnectWise makes software IT service providers use to manage and back up their clients' systems.

meme.top: One login for the backup tool
meme.bottom: Opened 173 front doors
meme.take: A backup tool's single login reached 173 companies. Efficient, in the wrong direction.

stories.title: Taiwan moves to make smuggling AI chips to China a crime
stories.summary: Taiwan plans to list AI servers and advanced chips as controlled goods, making unauthorized shipments to Chinese buyers a criminal offence.
stories.why: Taiwan makes most of the world's advanced chips, so its export rules matter for the US-China tech contest.
stories.happened: Economic Affairs Minister Kung Ming-hsin plans to add AI servers and advanced chips to Taiwan's controlled commodities, Startup Fortune reports. Unauthorized shipments to Chinese buyers would be a crime under the Foreign Trade Act.
stories.next: Watch for the formal rule change and how it is enforced.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: AI chips are at the centre of US-China tensions.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Smuggling has been a gap in existing export controls.

stories.background: Taiwan is home to TSMC, which manufactures most of the world's most advanced chips.

meme.top: Taiwan makes the world's best chips
meme.bottom: Now it is checking the luggage
meme.take: Taiwan will criminalize AI chip smuggling, so the servers will have to declare themselves.

stories.title: Apple's new App Store rules target AI deepfakes and 'nudify' apps
stories.summary: Developers must now prevent and remove AI-made nonconsensual intimate images, and apps that hide such features from reviewers are banned.
stories.why: Nudify apps have spread fast, and app stores are under pressure to stop them.
stories.happened: MacRumors reports Apple updated guideline 1.2 to require apps to prevent and remove AI-generated nonconsensual intimate imagery. New guideline 2.5.19 targets apps that hide features during review and add nudify functions later.
stories.next: Watch for apps being removed under the new rules.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Nonconsensual deepfake images cause real harm to the people depicted.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Regulators worldwide are pressing platforms on AI abuse.

stories.background: Apple reviews every app before it appears on the App Store, its iPhone app marketplace.

meme.top: Apple updated its App Store rules
meme.bottom: Apps that hide things get hidden
meme.take: Apple now bans apps that act innocent during review, ending a long tradition.
